en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. My father and ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain both narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali Al-Washā, from Aḥmad ibn ‘Ā`idh, from Abī Khadījah, who said: A man asked Abā Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) about going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.).
Imam (a.s.) replied, “It is equal to one Hajj and one ‘Umrah and this much – he stretched open his arms – rewards.”
